facts.value: Input recognition uses the pool double 2^52 as the compiler conversion bias when comparing the unsigned vertical-tilt timer against floating-point xD8. Generic doEnter uses f32 zero for animation frame and blend and f32 one for playback speed. The pool is loaded, not written, by the reviewed routines.
facts.rationale: Input recognition also reads this section: the first eight bytes are a conversion bias, not padding.

facts.value: A sixteen-byte .sdata2 pool: big-endian f64 4503599627370496 (2^52) at offset zero, f32 zero at offset eight and f32 one at offset twelve. Bytes are 4330000000000000000000003f800000 in both existing objects. The double is a timer conversion bias, not padding. Split section flags are SHF_ALLOC; source flags are SHF_ALLOC|SHF_WRITE.
facts.rationale: Correct the false padding interpretation and distinguish existing ELF permissions.
